desc: Parse H, W, X, P, Q and the full strength grid, converting coordinates to 0-based indexing.
Design greedy min-heap expansion with strict inequality S*X < current.
Implement the greedy min-heap solution (heapq + visited grid, mark-on-push, push unabsorbed neighbors on absorption, stop when the smallest boundary slime is not absorbable).
Test the implementation against sample 1 (28), sample 2 (5), sample 3 (1343) -- all passed.
Verify edge cases and complexity: O(HW log(HW)) time, O(HW) memory, Python big int arithmetic avoids overflow/precision issues.
